reviews.review:
Up to four foreign invaders descend on a peaceful planet, destroying its natural beauty and killing its indigenous life. But these invaders are themselves oppressed. They are culturally and economically coerced into taking high-risk jobs while the lion's share of their labors go to their corporate owners.

11/10, a fearless examination of class warfare from the perspective of those who are both victims and perpetrators of a meat-grinder, race-to-the-bottom existence.

This game is a hidden gem... 

Pun aside, this is an early access review and I am at about 26 hours of playtime.  The game has numerous 'under construction' areas in the space station lobby and is not a finished prduct.  It has numerous ways it can grow in depth and I will be sure to feed the devs some insight and criticism in the discussion forum as I have been thinking about this game a lot.  

Despite all of that, this game feels good when you play it.  It is hard when it should be, and it is different enough each time in order to make the player feel like they are doing something.  The Perks and Milestones mechanism is a good leading method to unlocking the game.  The character upgrade method ensures a lengthy gameplay experience in order to receive all the unlocks.  It could do with 2 weapon/item unlocks per slot with different features for each class and about 2 more upgrades per item to add depth.  If this is done correctly with trade-offs to each choice it will make this game a power-house in coopertive 'dungeon' roaming.  The game feels corny, but in conjunction with the ambience, voice actors, themes, and the art style it fits and it brings it all together into a very pleasurable experience with swearing dwarves.

--26NOV19 Update--
Guess what?!  Game is still awesome and the content they have released this calendar year is noteworthy for the small dev-team.

--25FEB20 Update--
At about 275 hours of playtime now and still making time to drop onto Hoxxes for my weekly missions.  There is still a lot of overclock modules to find and beers to acquire a license for. There has been a surge of newer players lately which has been great to see!

--27JUN20 Update--
At over 333 hours I come back for weeks at a time to gather resources.  Waiting for the next great update push.  I still love playing this in a pre-made team or jumping around the server to random groups.  Everyone is always so friendly.  Tons of cosmetics and cores I can still collect.  I am not that grindy of a person.

--28NOV20 Update--
The new missions are GREAT!  Still plenty of awesome things coming on the game roadmap.  Let's just hope for that 5th dwarf to sign onto the company roster.

--13DEC23 Update--
Game is still kicking! I am over 500 hours on it and I still like to get new players into it. Still trying to unlock everything. There are people that seemingly never stopped playing.
